title: Revisiting the Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning

methods.one_paragraph_description: Revisited BRAC: TD3+BC with decoupled behavior-regularization penalties (beta1 MSE penalty on the actor, beta2 penalty on the critic), three hidden layers in actor and critic, LayerNorm between critic layers, larger batch (1024) with scaled learning rate on Gym-MuJoCo, and adjusted discount on AntMaze. At runtime it is a deterministic TD3-style actor-critic.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL; 'a more general version of BRAC built on top of the TD3+BC algorithm' (Section 3); ensemble-free, behavior-regularized actor-critic

batch_size.quote: batch size                            1024 on Gym-MuJoCo, 256 on other

learning_rate.quote: learning rate (all networks)          1e-3 on Gym-MuJoCo, 3e-4 on Adroit and V-D4RL, 1e-4 on Antmaze

layernorm.value: LayerNorm between each layer of the critic networks
layernorm.quote: using offline datasets in online RL. Following these works, in our approach, we also apply LayerNorm between each layer of the critic networks.

training_steps.quote: Gym-MuJoCo and v1 for Adroit. The agents were trained for one million steps and evaluated over ten episodes.

beta1_search_grid.quote: For ReBRAC, we fine-tuned the β1 parameter for the actor, which was selected from 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1. Similarly, the β2 parameter for the critic was selected from a range of

beta2_search_grid.quote: 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1. Similarly, the β2 parameter for the critic was selected from a range of 0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.5. The selected best parameters for each dataset are reported in Table 11.
